chapter_title: The Effects of Viscum album (Mistletoe) QuFrF Extract and Vincristine in Human Multiple Myeloma Cell Lines - A Comparative Experimental Study Using Several and Different Parameters
source_pdf: /mnt/project-files/Experimental Provenance for QSAR Dataset/Pharmacology (Luca Gallelli) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

records.target: specific IL-6 receptors (IL-6R alpha / CD126 and gp130 / CD130)
records.role_detail: endogenous ligand; direction (agonist) inferred from the signal cascade the book says the complex initiates
records.mechanism_book_wording: The biological activity of IL-6 depends on binding to its specific receptors. ... The complex IL-6+IL-6R+gp130 initiate a signal transduction cascade through JAKs (Janus kinases) and STATs
records.quote: The biological activity of IL-6 depends on binding to its specific receptors.
records.notes: The word agonist is not used for IL-6 itself; the Agonist role is inferred from the stated signal initiation.

records.target: IL-6 / IL-6 receptor complex (IL-6+sIL-6R with gp130)
records.role_detail: soluble receptor protein described by the book as an agonist that enhances IL-6 activity
records.mechanism_book_wording: As agonist, sIL-6R enhances the biological activity of IL-6
records.quote: As agonist, sIL-6R enhances the biological activity of IL-6 and sgp130 is an antagonist against the complex IL-6+sIL-6R.
records.notes: Target named in the sentence is the IL-6 / IL-6+sIL-6R complex; target class receptor is inferred (IL-6 receptor system). Same sentence supports the sgp130 record.

records.role_detail: soluble signal-transducing component acting as antagonist against the IL-6+sIL-6R complex
records.mechanism_book_wording: sgp130 is an antagonist against the complex IL-6+sIL-6R
records.quote: sgp130 is an antagonist against the complex IL-6+sIL-6R.
records.notes: Target class receptor is inferred (complex of receptor proteins); the book names the target as the complex IL-6+sIL-6R.

records.role_detail: antagonism of membrane IL-6R expression; book leaves open whether competitive or non-competitive antagonist
records.mechanism_book_wording: VAQuFrF could effect the membrane expression of IL-6 receptor by antagonism
records.quote: The results presented in this study indicated that VAQuFrF could effect the membrane expression of IL-6 receptor by antagonism.
records.numbers_detail: Dose 50 ug/10^6 cells (PDF 606). Table 3 membrane IL-6R expression, percent of untreated (=100), VAQuFrF alone: 24 h LP-1 28, RPMI-8226 61, OPM-2 94; 48 h LP-1 34, RPMI-8226 42, OPM-2 92 (PDF 606)
records.notes: Extract (mistletoe lectins and viscotoxin); the book does not say which component acts. Key results (PDF 615) state: VAQuFrF inhibits the membrane expression of this receptor.

chapter_notes: Receptor/enzyme records are 4 (3 endogenous IL-6 system members, 1 extract). 3 statements on non-receptor/non-enzyme targets were skipped under the 2026-11-23 update: vincristine binding to tubulin (PDF 614), vincristine as CCS blocker / blocking mitotic spindle formation (PDF 601), and VAQuFrF decreasing Bcl-2 levels (PDF 611). PDF 617-618 are the reference list and were not extracted.
